title: IDD Local Validation Evidence Marker Payload
description: Structured payload parsed from an idd-local-validation-evidence comment on a pull request.

actor.description: GitHub login of the recording actor, as embedded in the marker (display only; the comment's actual GitHub author is the trust evidence).

headSha.description: The pull request HEAD commit the local validation ran against. A resolution for any other live HEAD treats this record as wrongHead.

commandSet.description: Name of the configured local command set that ran (typically pre-push-validate).

covers.description: Required GitHub check names this run is asserted to substitute evidence for. Never a claim that any platform check itself passed.

outcome.description: Outcome of the local command set run.

createdAt.description: The GitHub-assigned created_at of the comment carrying this marker, or "none" when unavailable. Used to compute recency against the configured localValidationEvidence.maxAge; never itself embedded in the marker body.
